description: Chunk-group verification: chunkRoot of 16 KiB chunk sub-trees, the per-block outboard, and rejections. SHA-384 with domain bytes 0x10, 0x11, 0x12.

rejected.name: chunkHashFlipped
rejected.description: One bit of a chunk-leaf hash in the outboard is flipped: it no longer authenticates against the signed chunkRoot

rejected.name: proofSiblingFlipped
rejected.description: One bit of a proof sibling is flipped

rejected.name: outboardOfAnotherBlock
rejected.description: The outboard of block 0 is presented for block 1 (same length, wrong index in the proof)

rejected.name: outboardTruncated
rejected.description: The outboard is one hash short

rejected.name: chunkContentChanged
rejected.description: A chunk with one bit flipped fails at its own leaf hash

rejected.name: chunkTooShort
rejected.description: A chunk that is one byte short of its expected length

rejected.name: chunkAtWrongIndex
rejected.description: The correct bytes of chunk 3 are delivered as chunk 2: the leaf hash binds the index

rejected.name: lastChunkWithPaddedLength
rejected.description: The short last chunk of the file padded to 16 KiB
